context_visible: Aerial view of a rural settlement with a paved road running vertically through the center.
A river flows horizontally across the upper portion of the image, separating the village from agricultural fields.
The fields in the background are divided into rectangular plots with varying shades of green and brown.
The village consists of densely packed single-story structures with pitched roofs in red, grey, and blue.
Bare deciduous trees and patches of white snow are visible on the ground and rooftops, indicating a cold season.
cross_view_relations: The crop image is a zoomed-in view of the area to the right of the central road and below the river.
The crop highlights a specific cluster of buildings and a small garden plot that are part of the larger village context.
The spatial relationship confirms the crop is a subset of the wider scene, focusing on the residential density near the water.
